 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz 'PBB Collab 3.0': Shea Valerio 'hurt, confused' by Jeo Ong's actions 
 By GMA News Published November 14, 2026 6:46pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: PBB "Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0" housemate Shea Valerio admitted feeling hurt and confused after learning about Jeo Ong's reasons for distancing himself from her.
 During a conversation with Kuya in the confession room on Saturday’s episode, Shea opened up about learning that Jeo's previous actions toward her were purely platonic.
 “He said that he treats all of us equally. So everything he shows me, all his actions toward me, are purely platonic. We're really just friends,” Shea said.
 Shea admitted that she initially struggled to understand Jeo's sudden change in behavior, especially since she had noticed how attentive he was toward her.

 She recalled how fellow housemates had also pointed out that Jeo seemed to be more caring toward her.
 “From the beginning, they would tell me, ‘Why does Jey seem to be more caring toward you?’ But I would always tell them, ‘That's just how he is with everyone,’” she recalled.
 Shea also shared how Jeo would often keep her company whenever she ate alone.
 However, she acknowledged that she may have misinterpreted his gestures and no longer wanted to assume anything about his feelings.
 “I was hurt and confused, but I'm already at the acceptance stage,” she said.
 She added that she would rather know where Jeo stands than continue wondering whether she had done something wrong.
 “At least he knows how he feels. That way, I won't be left wondering what I did wrong,” she said.
 Shea stressed that she has no problem with Jeo seeing her only as a friend and respects his intentions.
 “If that's how he sees his actions toward me, and if that was really his intention, then that's okay. I have no problem with that,” she said.
 What hurt her more, however, was Jeo's sudden decision to avoid her, which left her feeling as though she was being blamed for their closeness.
 “I would understand if I knew that I had said something wrong to him. I would know what to do. Of course, I would apologize and talk to him. But it all happened so suddenly,” she said.
 Shea also expressed how the situation made her question herself.
 “I just don't want things to be this way. I don't want to feel like I'm the bad person just because I became close to him. Is that my fault?” she said.
 “I feel like I'm the one who did something wrong. I feel like I'm at fault because I'm the one he's avoiding,” she added.
 Despite the hurt and confusion, Shea said she was beginning to accept Jeo's feelings and intentions, even if it meant letting go of what she initially thought their connection was.
 Previously, Jeo explained why he has been keeping his distance from Shea after the latter noticed a sudden change in his behavior.
 Jeo said that he decided to keep a little distance after the other male housemates teased him about Shea feeding him. He also learned about Shea's admiration for him, which caught him off guard.
 "PBB: Collab 3.0" premiered on October 24. Sixteen housemates, composed of celebrity personalities, social media stars, and ordinary netizens, entered the new PBB house.
 The series airs on GMA Network from Mondays to Fridays at 9:35 p.m., Saturdays at 6:15 p.m., and Sundays at 4:45 p.m. —Jade Veronique Yap/JCB, GMA News
